hook.name: TokenHook
hook.description: A DEX-tax hook that intercepts exactInput swaps post-execution: on buys (TOKEN as output) it takes TAX_RATE of the token output and sends it to a treasury; on sells (non-TOKEN as output) it takes REWARD_RATE and credits it to the seller via an external ITokenRewards contract. Both fees are applied via afterSwapReturnDelta.
